response.title: which solar generator with panels included is ready to use out of the box
response.answer:
If you're looking for a solar generator that includes solar panels and works right out of the box, I recommend buying a complete solar generator kit from EcoFlow, Jackery, BLUETTI, or Anker SOLIX.

These kits typically include the battery power station, compatible solar panels, and charging cables. You don't need to buy a separate inverter, charge controller, or battery.

The important distinction is to choose a package labeled “Solar Generator Kit” or “Solar Generator + Solar Panel”, rather than a standalone portable power station.
